altJa: 白い一枚のシートを広げ、柔らかく波打つひだを付けたイラスト。表面には不規則な細かな繊維状の模様が見えます。
observationJa: 連続したシートの広がり、柔らかく曲がる端やひだ、つやを抑えた表面を見ます。細かな繊維状の模様は、この図での表面の表し方です。
limitJa: 一般的な外観の一例です。白い色や描かれた表面だけで材質を特定しません。この図から繊維の組成、厚さ、通気性、保温性、防虫などの性能を判定できません。

generation.exactPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original material-name recognition illustration for an adult Japanese agriculture learning app. Primary request: ONE white soft nonwoven agricultural covering sheet, partly unfolded and loosely draped in a low gentle mound, with a wide continuous sheet surface and soft rounded folds, one clearly visible loose edge. Gentle botanical-atlas 2D watercolor/gouache style on quiet warm ivory background, restrained warm gray shadows giving white-on-ivory contrast. Surface has subtle randomly distributed soft short fiber-like texture, matte rather than glossy. Readable complete silhouette, entire sheet within comfortable margins in a square composition; modest three-quarter view. It must look like supple lightweight fibrous covering material, not a hard plastic panel, paper stack, tissue box, woven cloth or fishing net. No regular mesh holes, grid, woven yarn pattern, numerically measurable pores, cutaway or exaggerated fraying. No plants, crops, tunnel hoops, machinery, hands, packaging, roll core, labels, text, numbers, symbols, logos, watermark or border. Do not imply fiber composition, precise thickness, air permeability, heat retention, waterproofness, insect protection or any product performance. This is only one common illustrative appearance example. Entirely original composition, no textbook photograph or page layout copying. No input/reference images.
